quarterly_data.signal: Wafer-level packaging capacity (IR deck 07-08-2026): the company has decided to expand 12-inch copper-pillar bump (CPB) capacity to secure next-generation high-spec packaging infrastructure, and says it is winning more orders from high-growth applications such as AI servers and automotive (AI chipsets, automotive PMIC) while raising the share of high-margin processes. Market view in the deck: AI-server chip demand is driving demand for high-performance packaging and geopolitical risk is accelerating supply-chain reshuffling.
quarterly_data.figure: 12-inch CPB capacity expansion decided; no specific figure

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (IR deck 07-08-2026): the company expects AI, data-center and autonomous-driving demand to keep expanding and continued packaging demand as domestic foundry capacity is added; in electronic materials it expects faster localisation by Korean chipmakers and rising demand for HBM materials (copper plating solution for HBM), calling HBM-oriented high-performance materials a source of structural growth; in lead tabs it expects new fire-retardant safety products for EVs to ramp.

Strategy and FY2025 business mix (IR deck 07-08-2026): three strategic pillars for the bumping business - (1) mobile and consumer core business as the cash-flow base, (2) AI infrastructure solutions (power delivery / power management, silicon capacitors, memory controllers), (3) AI advanced packaging (2.5D integration, fan-out / PLP). Nepes Ark (test) pillars: global top-tier CIS customers, co-growth with strategic foundries in automotive AI / robotics / infotainment, and turnkey advanced packages (2.5D, 3D, FoPLP) with Nepes. Advanced-packaging materials: Cu plating, fine-pitch bump PR, C4 bump PR, fine-pitch RDL PR and RDL PSPI for TSV, CPB and RDL formation in HBM / DDR5 and 2.5D packages. FY2025 (KRW x 100M): semiconductor 4,110 vs 3,930 (4.6%), IT materials 916 vs 783 (17%), lead tab 765 vs 538 (42%); consolidated revenue 5,207 vs 4,636 (12%); consolidated operating profit 237 (4.6% margin) vs 34 (0.7%); Nepes Ark test revenue 1,140 vs 1,190 (-4%) with operating profit 48 vs -26 (turned profitable). 2025 revenue mix: semiconductor 68%, lead tab 18%, IT materials 15%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 consolidated revenue KRW 5,207 x 100M (12% YoY), OP 237 x 100M (4.6%); semiconductor 68% of revenue
